notes.title: Patch Coming soon!
notes.notes:
Not a set release date but in the next week or so you can expect a patch, it will once again relook at a lot of the UI making it a bit more streamlined and there will also most likely be another map included.  If the map isn't included in this patch it will be released within a week of the patch. (completely free) 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Artillery Cats patch notes v1.1
Mostly bug fixes and a new UI

-Complete UI revamp which should be much easier to use
-Fixed bug where trebuchet cats special stacked up infinitely as the player collected more bomb power ups
-Fixed bug not allowing the player to shoot bombs into the center of 8 player maps
-You can now set lobbies to open in between rounds to have more people join without restarting the lobby
- A few other small QOL fixes


Hopefully this patch alleviates some of the issues people have brought up. Please report any new bugs that may pop up and once again thanks for playing!

notes.title: Release pushed back one week to June 19th.
notes.notes: Sorry for the delay but issues with the menu and multiplayer lobby system still need cleaning up and another week will allow for it to be done well and tested properly.  The game itself is working smoothly so this should be easy to handle with another week of effort.  Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Release date set for June 12
notes.notes: All is going well and the launch for Artillery Cats should be on June 12th as planned.  Just have one more cat skin to create and some menus that need cleaning up.  Other than that just looking forward to having a clean launch.
